description:
The Huffy Enigma 20" BMX Freestyle Bike is made for riders who want to push limits and express their style on every ride. Its durable steel freestyle frame is built to handle jumps, tricks, and everyday riding, giving riders the confidence to take on the street, the park, or the neighborhood.
Wide freestyle tires provide steady traction and control on pavement, ramps, and dirt. The single-speed drivetrain keeps riding simple and responsive, while a strong 3-piece crank helps transfer power efficiently for quick acceleration and smooth trick setups.
Tall BMX handlebars with a crossbar deliver strong leverage and control when landing tricks or carving through turns. Freestyle pegs on the non-drive side add versatility for stalls and creative moves, while the rear U-brake provides reliable stopping power when it’s time to slow things down.

components.description: Rear U-Brake Control: Responsive rear U-brake offers reliable stopping power without getting in the way of tricks.
20" x 2.125" tires provide steady grip and control on pavement, ramps, and dirt.
